page_title: JetBrains Toolbox App: Manage Your Tools with Ease

sources.entry: JetBrains Toolbox App - Manage installed JetBrains tools, download new ones and open recent projects. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: JetBrains Toolbox App
summary.one_liner: A desktop app for installing, updating, and managing JetBrains IDEs and their projects from one place.
use_cases: Installing and updating JetBrains IDEs without full re-downloads
Rolling back to an earlier IDE version
Opening recent or favorite projects in the correct IDE
Trying JetBrains EAP or Android Studio canary builds
Managing IDEs on remote Linux, Windows, or macOS machines
Cloning GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket repos from the browser
summary.what_it_does: Installs, updates, and manages JetBrains IDEs, with updates applied as patches in the background and plugins updated alongside the IDE. Users can read release notes before updating, roll back or downgrade, and keep several versions of the same tool. It lists projects with favorites pinned to the top, searchable, and opens each one in the correct IDE with a click. It also supports installing and managing IDEs on remote machines and offers browser extensions for Chrome and Firefox to clone and open repositories.
notable: Patch-based background updates with plugins updated together with the IDE
Rollback and downgrade of IDE versions
Install and manage IDEs on remote machines
Browser extensions to clone and open GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket repos
caveats: Manages JetBrains tools (and Android Studio builds); it is not an IDE itself
Pricing not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing marks it as freeware
